title: Section K: Business Rule & Financial Consistency Verification
description: Validates invoice mathematical consistency, 3-way Purchase Order matching, contract chronological terms, and duplicate invoice fraud prevention.

assertions.name: Invoice_Line_Item_Math_Summation
assertions.message: Line-item summation ($1000.00) and total calculation ($1045.00) verified.

assertions.name: Three_Way_PO_Matching_Verification
assertions.message: 3-Way match reconciled Invoice, Purchase Order, and Goods Receipt with 100% price/vendor parity.

assertions.name: Contract_Date_Chronology_And_Terms_Validation
assertions.message: Contract verified: Effective date precedes expiration date and notice period complies with policy.

assertions.name: Duplicate_Invoice_Fraud_Detection
assertions.message: Duplicate detection engine flagged duplicate invoice submission from existing vendor.
